notes: Timeline = audio/song.wav (ffmpeg decode of the mp3); stems separated from the same file, zero offset. Method: CTC emissions (20 ms) of the Demucs vocal stem from torchaudio MMS_FA and wav2vec2-large-lv60k-960h on the mono sum and L/R channels, fused as a probability mixture; one global constrained Viterbi alignment of all lead lines with a garbage token between lines to absorb ad-libs (parenthesised lyrics, listed under 'adlibs'); signal refinement of word starts/ends on the vocal stem; cross-check against faster-whisper large-v3 word timestamps. conf: 0.35 + agreement of independent alignments + CTC posterior + Whisper agreement. 'syl' = per-part timings of hyphenated tokens (ooh-oh).
